scope: Read-only C++ runtime, descriptor, GPU state and readback integration review
review_checks: FrameContext owns histogram, Bloom chains and diagnostic readback. Its graphics fence retires before descriptor rewrites, resource reuse and Map. Resize flushes both queues before recreating size-dependent targets.

One persistent double-buffered float4 exposure record alternates after successful Present and Signal together with temporal commit. Resets invalidate both temporal and exposure readiness, forcing seed initialization.

Typed float4 clear alias initializes four distinct exposure channels. Structured SRV/UAV views match the shader record. The histogram uses a typed uint clear alias and 258-element structured dispatch views.

FrameGraph orders PrepareExposure, GBuffer/Lighting, TemporalResolve, HistogramBuild, ExposureAdapt, Bloom down/up, ToneMap and diagnostic CopySource readback. Same-queue transitions and UAV ordering cover clear/build dependencies; persistent records return to Common.

Lighting, emissive GBuffer and sky share prior exposure. Temporal history rescales previous color by prior display/pre-exposure ratio. Metering removes current pre-exposure before logarithmic binning. ToneMap applies current display/prior display ratio.
Bloom source and destination resources are distinct. Runtime derives each dispatch dimensions from its resource, handles odd dimensions using ceil-halving and maintains independent down/up chains.

Retired diagnostic copy checks all exposure components finite, positive multipliers and nonnegative meter. Histogram sum equals finite count, and finite plus invalid count equals that submitted frame viewport.
remaining_validation: R3 multi-configuration and GPU resource numerical probes remain in progress with the capture owner. Time-varying scene illumination is a separate remaining acceptance item.
